spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation of the Chapter
 of
 the Three
 Vessels

---


**
¶2.
**
 Concerning what
 you have asked about
 the containing
 forms:
 understand
 that
 when the Divine
 itself
 was
 preparing
 to
 release
 these three recept
acles of
 spiritual substance, it
 poured them into
 the natural mind one
 after
 another,
 each
 according
 to the
 proper
 state
 and
 stage
 of regeneration. It
 released
 them and cast them down into
 the external
 man
.


**¶3.** Then
 the
 Divine drew them up
 out
 of the natural mind by
 means
 of three kinds of external truth — tru
ths of understanding,
 truths of knowledge, and truths
 proce
eding from the
 will
 — which clothed the spiritual man
. It directed
 them and
 caused
 them to flow into the three deep
 receptacles established during the original
 formation of the mind's interior
 structure. Yet
 something remained behind in
 the outermost natural mind from
 these
 three containing
 forms, so that you may
 find their trace
 and lik
eness displayed throughout
 the whole mind.

**¶
4.** The resid
ue remaining
 in the
 realm
 of truth
 is the bitterness and harsh
ness of merely natural knowledge —
 general
 knowledge dev
oid of spiritual life —
 which surrounds and bounds the entire
 understanding.


**¶5.** And
 the resid
ue remaining
 from fals
ity is an elevated state of dense ignor
ance that stands precisely where Divine wisdom first
 rises
 into
 the understanding. For
 when the Lord's wisdom would illuminate the
 mind
, no light is
 visible there, because the falsity that
 p
ours forth
 from that state manif
ests above
 it
 and
 obscures all
 illumin
ation.

**¶6.
** And
 the resid
ue remaining from self
-love, in
 the
 natural mind, consists
 of all
 those
 elevated
 and
 isolated states from
 which exhalations of sel
fish desire
 rise
 up
 and
 become
 manifest
. For
 these
 are the
 remnant
 of the great containing form of infernal
 love —
 the
 ves
tige con
joined with that
 self-love which
 ascends from the lowest natural —
 together
 with those
 l
ofty and
 sw
ollen states of
 pride
,
 those
 places
 where no perception
 bears good works, where
 the faculties of perception are wholly
 barren and
 cannot
 bring
 forth any fruit
 of
 life.

**¶8.
** Know
 this:
 when the Divine released
 these containing
 forms from the
 interior
 mind down
 into
 the natural, it
 was done
 for
 this purpose
 —
 so
 that the fals
ified truths, the
 falsities, and the self
-love already dwelling within
 the several degrees of the natural mind
 would be drawn out
 by
 affinity and
 ascend toward that
 which had descended from above, and so
 that
 the natural mind in
 all
 its degrees would be purified and cle
ansed. For
 this reason
 the Divine p
oured these containing forms —
 of
 truth
, of falsity, and of love
 — down
 into the natural:
 so
 that the corresponding
 corru
ptions already
 existing
 in the natural
 would
 be drawn upward toward
 their
 like and
 thereby
 removed
.


**¶9.** First
 of
 all, the Divine disch
arged falsified truth — the waste and
 poison of the ruling
 evils that
 dominate the interior understanding
. It
 cle
ansed the heavenly regions of the
 mind
 of corru
pted knowledge
 and
 p
oured down
 the dark tru
ths.
 Just
 as these
 fals
ified
 truths fell from
 the
 interior
 mind into the natural, so also
 the falsified truths dwelling
 below
 in the natural were drawn upward from
 the lowest
 degree
 toward
 the
 corru
ptions
 that had descended from
 above. The natural mind was thereby pur
ified of the destructive falsity min
gled
 with
 its truths. Then the Divine swept
 them
 out
ward and made
 of
 them a great ou
termost boundary — a
 wall
 of general
 natural
 knowledge surrounding the whole understanding
 — upon which the
 doctrinal vessels of the church may
 still travel.

**¶10
.** After fals
ified truth,
 the Divine discharged pure falsity.
 It
 purified the interior understanding
 and dried from
 it the weight
 of darkness
 pressing
 upon it. It
 cast this falsity down
 into the natural mind. Just as it
 had purified the heavenly regions
,
 so also
 it purified the natural:
 the falsity dwelling in the natural mind
 was drawn up
ward toward the falsity that had descended
 from above. The
 Divine
 swept both out together
 and enclosed them in a contained
 state
 of darkness,
 bounded at
 the outermost edge
 of
 knowledge
.

**¶11.**
 And
 the
 Divine discharged self-love from the
 interior mind into the natural. At that
 time the self-love imprisoned in the
 lowest natural was drawn upward toward its
 own kind. Self-love was added
 to self-love. Afterward,
 the Divine swept it out and cast it
 into the ou
termost infernal state — the hell
 prepared
 for such loves beyond
 the boundaries
 of the whole
 order
 of the mind.

**¶
12.** In the same way that
 the Divine purified the interior understanding above
 as a clear pathway for the illuminations
 of wisdom to journey
 through
, so also it
 purified the degrees of the natural mind
 below, sweeping from them self-
love and
 falsity and corru
pted truth. It
 has
 purified them for the ascent of
 the three regenerating powers — spiritual understanding
, living truth, and celestial love
 — which rise before the Guardian who
 stands
 between the
 interior
 and exterior man
,
 and
 which
 traverse every degree
 of the natural mind from lowest to highest
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: As for what you have asked me about the vessels, you must understand this, that when the Father of Life was about to discharge these three vessels he poured the three upon this earth, one by one at its (appointed) hour and season. He discharged them and cast them down to the earth.
The element that is left in water is the pungency and the salinity of this salty inner sea that surrounds the worlds.

And the remnant that is left from the darkness is this black mountain that exists in the surroundings of the sunrise. For when the sun would shine over the world no sunlight is visible there, because the darkness that gushes from it manifests above it.

Happen you know this! When the Father of Life discharged these vessels from above upon the earth, he poured them out for this reason: so that also the water and the darkness and the fire that exist in these three earths would be drawn and ascend towards they that had come down from above, and the earths would be purified and cleansed. Due to this he poured these vessels down to the earth, of water and of darkness and of fire, so that also the water and darkness and fire that exist in the earths would be drawn up towards they that had descended from above.

Now, first of all, he discharged the water, the waste, the poison of the rulers who are above. He cleansed the firmaments of the [water and its dark waste, and] he poured down the dark waters. [Just as the] waters fell from heaven to earth, so also the waters below in the earths were drawn and came up from below towards the waters that had come from above to the earths. The waters [were] purified of the dark poison that exists in them. Then he swept them outside and made them a great vessel and a wall of sea that surrounds the universe, and on which the ships sail.

After the water, he discharged the darkness. He purified the firmaments and dried from them the darkness with which they are weighed down. He discharged it down to the earth. Just as he had purified the firmaments, so also he purified the earths. The darkness that is in the earths was drawn up towards the darkness that had been discharged from above. He swept them both out and shut them in that [black mountain] of darkness [that stands beyond] the water.

And he discharged the fire from heaven to earth, [and at] that time again the fire that was shut [in] the earth below was drawn and came up towards its kind. Fire was added to fire. Afterwards, he swept it out and cast it into the outer underworld, which [he had constructed for] them outside the universe.

In the same way that he purified the firmaments above as a place for the light-givers to journey [through them,] so also he purified the earths below and swept from them the fire and the darkness and the water[, and cast them out.] He has purified them for the ascent of these three powers, they of the wind and the water and the fire, which ascend before the Porter and traverse the earths.

Then he bailed and scooped them from this earth in these three garments, they of wind and of water and of fire, which swathed his body. He poured and made them flow into the three pits [ ... w]hich he had [es]tablished during the construc[tio]n of the worlds [ ... ] they [ ... ] something remained behind on the face of the earth from these three vessels, so that you can find their mark and type displayed in the universe.
